fields.title: Trial issuance goes through the existing issuer, synchronously
fields.context: the issuer already enforces entitlement; a second path would duplicate it
fields.decision: call the issuer inline and fail the request if it fails
fields.consequences: request latency now depends on the issuer; a queue would hide failures from the user, which F-2 shows is the current defect
fields.rejected: async via queue (hides failure); a second minting path (duplicates entitlement logic)
fields.falsifier: if p95 form latency exceeds 3s at 10x current trial volume, this was the wrong call
